title: Download selected authorized inventory-movement page as PDF
description: An inventory user downloads the selected bounded movement report page as a paginated Chinese PDF. Reuse ERP-130 authorized preview, current-user stock-query permission, existing PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver. Show base-unit and unknown-history evidence explicitly; render all selected columns without clipping by splitting wide column sets across pages, and show optional page-only status counts without summing incompatible units. Missing font fails explicitly; HTTP audit records read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify PDF and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses authorized bounded inventory preview, rechecks stock-query permission and all filters before any file bytes are returned.
PDFsharp renders selected fields, Chinese labels and unknown-history markers across row and column pages without clipping; shared SimHei resolver fails explicitly if font is unavailable.
Designer offers PDF download with visible authorization/empty/font failures; tests inspect PDF signature, field order, page bounds, unknowns, font failure and no writes; document font prerequisite.
